title: Where ZIA reads and writes disagree: an index of round-trip hazards

prose.text: Some ZIA fields read back differently from how they were written, and the detail for each lives in its own subject. This page only points to them.

prose.label: Sandbox default rule order.
prose.text: The default Sandbox rule reads as order 127 and what the API does with that value is open: [[zia.sandbox.rules]].

prose.label: Location time zone and country.
prose.text: The API recently changed how the Netherlands time zone is spelled and which form a write accepts is open: [[zia.locations.country-timezone]].

prose.label: Rule description whitespace.
prose.text: The provider suppresses description diffs and whether the server rewrites whitespace is open: [[zia.api.url-filtering-wire]].

prose.label: User authentication methods.
prose.text: The Terraform user resource accepts a narrower set than the API: [[zia.terraform.multi-step-writes]].

checks.do: Whether a drift or rejection on a rule, location or user is one of these known round-trip cases before treating it as a tenant change.
